        srcs(
            lines(
                "goog.module('p.A');",
                "/** @constructor */ var A = function() {}",
                "A.method = function() {}",
                "exports = A"),
            lines("goog.module('p.C');", "var {method} = goog.requireType('p.A');")),
        DOES_NOT_HAVE_EXPORT_WITH_DETAILS);

    testError(
